usages.explain: Expressing the meaning of something not being good, not smooth.

examples.content: 最近息子の成績がさっぱりだ。
examples.transcription: さいきんむすこのせいせきがさっぱりだ。
examples.mean: My son's grades have been good lately.

examples.content: 経済危機で新製品の売り上げがさっぱりだ。
examples.transcription: けいざいききでしんせいひんのうりあげがさっぱりだ。
examples.mean: Sales of new products have been weak due to the economic crisis.

title: さっぱりだ => There is nothing exciting or positive at all
